portal.noAccessDesc: Your user is not linked to a customer account.

contact.title: Your contact
contact.noResponsible: No responsible technician has been set yet.

booking.title: Book an available time
booking.desc: Choose a location, service and available time. The booking is confirmed immediately.
booking.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you need help with?
booking.successDuplicateTitle: Your request has already been sent
booking.nextStep1: The office reviews the request and checks that the equipment and time fit.
booking.nextStep2: You receive a confirmation with the final time only after the office has replied. If you picked an available day, we will try to keep it.
booking.nextStep3: You can follow the status under “Your requests”. There you can also cancel or request a new time.

errors.forbidden: This account is not allowed to send requests.
errors.missingFields: Enter a title, requested time and contact person before sending.
errors.invalid: Check the date, time window and contact information. The start time must be at least 24 hours ahead.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent many requests in a short time. Try again later.
errors.conflict: The time is no longer available, or you have too many open bookings. Choose another time or contact us.
errors.deadlinePassed: The deadline for requesting a new time has passed. You can still cancel the request.
errors.generic: The request could not be sent right now. Please try again shortly.

booking.windowError: The end time must be after the start time.

bookingRequests.title: Your requests
bookingRequests.desc: Requests awaiting a reply and confirmed appointments, with history.
bookingRequests.empty: You have not sent any requests yet.
bookingRequests.deadline: You can request a new time until {date}.
bookingRequests.pendingCancelNote: You can cancel the request even if the deadline for a new time has passed.
bookingRequests.inProgressNotice: The work is already in progress. Cancelling does not stop the ongoing work, but the office will be notified.
bookingRequests.cancelConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the request?
bookingRequests.cancelConfirmedConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the confirmed appointment? The office will be notified.
bookingRequests.cancelInProgressConfirm: The work is in progress. Do you want to mark the request as cancelled and notify the office? The appointment is not cancelled automatically.
bookingRequests.cancelSuccess: The request has been cancelled. It remains visible in your history.
bookingRequests.cancelInProgressSuccess: The request has been marked as cancelled. The work is already in progress, and the office has been notified. Contact them if the appointment should also be cancelled.
bookingRequests.rescheduleSuccess: Your request for a new time has been sent. The office will confirm the new time.
bookingRequests.leadTimeError: The new time must be at least {hours} hours ahead.

upcoming.title: Upcoming work orders
upcoming.desc: Confirmed work orders that are planned or in progress. Requests awaiting a reply are under “Your requests”.
